'''Arts and culture'''

**[[UK|British]] [[Islamophobia|anti-Islam]] [[far-right]] activist [[Tommy Robinson]] is sentenced to eighteen months imprisonment for [[Contempt of Court Act 1981|contempt of court]] and repeating false allegations about a [[Syrians in the United Kingdom|Syrian refugee]]. *[[Gaza humanitarian crisis (2023–present)|Gaza humanitarian crisis]]
**[[Israel]]'s [[Knesset]] votes 92–10 to ban the [[UNRWA]] from operating within Israel and the [[State of Palestine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/28/israel-parliament-approves-bill-to-ban-unrwa (Al Jazeera)]
*[[October 2024 Bulgarian parliamentary election]]
**The [[GERB-SDS]] coalition wins the most seats in the parliamentary election with 69 seats, with [[We Continue the Change – Democratic Bulgaria|PP-DB]] coming in second and [[Revival (Bulgarian political party)|Revival]] in third. GERB's leader [[Boyko Borisov]] promises to work with everyone except Revival to form a [[coalition government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bulgarias-gerb-party-wins-parliamentary-vote-preliminary-results-show-2024-10-28/ (Reuters)]
